issues: Remove printed keyword "storm" from keywords; Storm is conditional and should only be granted by the fanfare ability when hand count is 0.

The fanfare target/effect should allow selecting up to 2 enemy cards and destroying them, not use choose with min 1/max 2 duplicated single-destroy options; encode as a single destroy effect targeting enemyFieldCard with count up to 2 if supported.

The play restriction "This can't be played unless a follower you control has left the field this turn" is left as noop. It should be encoded as a real play restriction condition; implement an ability/op for play restrictions based on a follower you controlled leaving the field this turn.

The fanfare says "You may put a Naterran Great Tree token onto your field or into your EX area"; current choose requires exactly one option. Make the choice optional so you may choose neither destination.

On Evolve should let you put up to 2 Natura cards from the top 4 into your EX area, but searchDeckChoose only selects one. Encode selection of up to 2 cards and implement support for multi-pick search-from-top effects with remainder to bottom.

The activated cost is incorrectly encoded as cost.banishFromField/banishCount, which is not in the implemented cost schema. It should banish 2 cards named Naterran Great Tree from your field as an activation cost; implement a valid activated cost form for banishing cards from field by filter.

The activated ability should target a Natura follower on your field, but the target filter is incorrectly nested inside targets for selfFollower. Use a supported target selector/filter form for a Natura follower you control, or implement filtered field target support for target selectors.
Remove "strike" and "lastWords" from keywords; these are timings and should be represented by abilities, not printed keywords.
Strike is misencoded as dealDamageAllEnemies. It should deal 1 damage to each leader, i.e. both leaders, not all enemy followers and leader.
